image_description: An underwater close-up photograph of a grey whale (Eschrichtius robustus). The image focuses on the head and anterior body section. Visible features include the arched rostrum, mottled dark grey skin covered in white barnacle patches and callosities, and the absence of a dorsal fin. A pectoral flipper is visible along the side. The lighting is dim, typical of deep water, with some particulate matter suspended in the blue-green water.
